name: JBSA Lackland
description: Gateway to the Air Force — home of Basic Military Training and the 37th Training Wing. Over 35,000 recruits train here annually.

currentNotifications.title: BMT Graduation Traffic
currentNotifications.body: Expect heavy traffic near parade grounds on graduation Thursdays and Fridays. Arrive early and use designated parking.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, birth/marriage certificates if applicable, and all travel vouchers for finance settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your assigned unit upon arrival. Visit the Military Personnel Section within 24 duty hours for personnel actions, ID card updates, and DEERS enrollment.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Housing (210-671-1840) before arrival for on-base assignments. Unaccompanied housing available for eligible E1-E3 Airmen. Temporary lodging: Gateway Inn (210-671-3731).

sections.title: Permanent Party vs. Training
sections.body: BMT graduates follow-on to technical training. Permanent party Airmen coordinate with gaining unit and sponsor before arrival. AETC reporting instructions differ from AMC/ACC bases.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Key contacts: Security Forces 210-671-2018 | Housing 210-671-1840 | MPF 210-671-6006 | WHASC Medical 210-292-7412 | FSS/MWR 210-671-3722.
